C1626.title: Haidian Court Hears AI 'One-Click Undress' Obscene Materials Case
C1626.summary: On April 19, 2024, Haidian Court held a first-instance hearing in Bai Moumou's case of producing and selling obscene materials for profit. Prosecutors alleged that Bai used AI 'one-click undress' technology to create more than 6,000 images, over 1,500 of which were identified as obscene, and sold them through social messaging software.
